dice.title: Dice
dice.expressionHint: Dice, numbers, kh or kl to keep the highest or lowest, and damage tags in brackets.
dice.dcHint: The kept roll is compared with this DC for a degree of success.
dice.targetHint: The kept roll is dealt to this target as damage. Untagged dice and numbers are untyped.
dice.persistentTaken: Persistent damage: {taken} at the end of each turn

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Check rules data against Pioneer’s schemas: predicates, selectors, domains, roll options, sources, origins and rule elements, try a formula with your own reference values, or see whether a predicate holds.
rules.schemaHint: Changing the schema loads a valid example for it.
rules.jsonHint: Strings need double quotes, as in any JSON.
rules.formulaHint: Numbers, + - * /, brackets, @ references like @level or @attr.str, and functions like max and floor.
rules.formulaValid: The formula as Pioneer prints it:
rules.referencesHint: A value for each @ reference in the formula. Clear a box to leave its reference without a value.
rules.referenceInvalid: Enter a whole number from {minimum} to {maximum}. Until then, this reference has no value.
rules.referenceUnknown: Pioneer has no such reference, so stored formulas cannot use it.
rules.referenceFoundry: This is Foundry’s spelling. Stored formulas write {suggestion}.
rules.formulaTree: Parsed tree, with each part’s position:
rules.factsHint: One per line, like self:level:5 or terrain:forest. A missing self, feat or class option counts as false; a missing terrain, target or action option is unknown.
rules.badFacts: {count, plural, one {Line {lines} is not a roll option.} other {Lines {lines} are not roll options.}}
rules.factsNotChecked: Fix the roll options to see the verdict.

verdict.unknown: The predicate depends on the situation: some roll options it needs were not given.

rules.valid: Valid. This is the value as Pioneer reads it:
rules.notJson: This is not valid JSON yet. Check quotes, commas and brackets.
rules.invalidSummary: {count, plural, one {# problem, listed under Result.} other {# problems, listed under Result.}}
rules.nothingToShow: Nothing to check until the JSON parses.
